decisionsTitle: «Prezența» lists the elites first, then the partners' runners with their partner's name, then everybody else, each by race number
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-20, the day before the race, with a picture of «Prezența»'s «De ridicat numărul (172)» — 050 Adelina Matei, 204 Adrian Brănescu, 006 Adrian Iacob, 070 Adriana Barascu, by the name as typed:** «pe pagina asta de „Prezență” în ziua cursei, aranjează tot alfabetic» — and, asked whether by surname or by first name: «sortează după BIB»; then «și pune elitele primii, apoi pune-i pe cei de la parteneri și cu numele partenerului (Onlypus, Regalina, etc)». The desk hands the bibs out of a pile ordered by number, the elites and the partners' runners first.

**Decision.** Inside every section of the desk (§1002) the rows come in three groups — the registrations marked «Elită» (§897), then those «De la parteneri» (a partner's name on the registration), then everybody else — and inside each group by the race number the row shows, a confirmed registration's as `raceNumberOf` draws it (§548), lowest first; a row that shows none (not confirmed, or confirmed and still without a number) comes after its group's numbers, by name; the id settles a tie (`admin-repository.ts#listDeskRegistrations`). A partner's runner wears on the row the registrations list's own chip «Partener: {name}» (glyph `fromPartner`), for every desk role — the club's sponsor's name, never the person's own data. The sections, their order, their counts and the search are unchanged: a search lists its matches the same way.
changelogLine: - **«Prezența» in the desk's order** — in every section the elites first, then the partners' runners with «Partener: {name}» on their row, then everybody else, each group by race number, those without a number after them by name. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the race-day desk, when its rows are drawn — the list, a search — then every section lists the registrations marked «Elită» first, then those with a partner's name, then the others, each group by the race number a confirmed registration shows, lowest first, the rows that show none after them by name, then by id; a partner's runner's row carries «Partener: {name}» for every desk role (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `registrations/race-day-desk-sections.test.ts`, `registrations/one-bib-download.test.ts`.
